meta.scalability_note: 3 Swedish zones (Stockholm sto1, sto2, sto3); OpenStack Heat auto-scaling; managed K8s; no serverless FaaS
meta.performance_note: ISO 27001; ISO 14001 (environmental); 99.9% SLA; Swedish data residency; NVMe storage; GDPR-compliant

AWS Amplify.note: No managed full-stack application platform available

Amazon ECS.note: No managed container runtime without Kubernetes

Amazon EKS.note: Fully managed K8s with auto-scaling, persistent storage integration, and GitOps support

Amazon EC2.note: Flexible VM instances, NVMe SSD, multiple flavors

AWS Batch.note: No managed batch compute service available

AWS Elastic Beanstalk.note: No managed PaaS application deployment service available

Amazon S3.note: Multi-zone within Stockholm region, S3 API, bucket versioning

AWS Backup.note: VM and volume snapshots available; no centralised cross-service backup policy engine

Amazon EFS.note: No managed elastic NFS file system available

Amazon RDS.note: Managed PostgreSQL available; limited to PostgreSQL, less automated than RDS

Amazon DocumentDB.note: No managed document database service available

Amazon DynamoDB.note: No managed NoSQL key-value store available

Amazon Aurora.note: No managed high-performance relational database compatible with MySQL/PostgreSQL at Aurora scale

Amazon ElastiCache.note: No managed in-memory caching service (Redis/Memcached) available

Amazon Redshift.note: No managed data warehouse service available

AWS Application Load Balancer.note: HTTP/HTTPS load balancing; basic routing; less feature-rich than AWS ALB

AWS Network Load Balancer.note: TCP mode via the same Octavia service

Amazon VPC.note: Private networks, security groups, floating IPs, routers

Amazon Route 53.note: Basic DNS management via OpenStack; no health-check routing or traffic policies

Amazon API Gateway.note: No managed API gateway service available

AWS Direct Connect.note: No dedicated private network connection service available

Amazon Rekognition.note: No managed image/video analysis AI service available

Amazon SageMaker.note: No managed ML model training and deployment platform available

Amazon Bedrock.note: No managed foundation model/generative AI service available

AWS Glue.note: No managed ETL and data integration service available

Amazon EMR.note: No managed big data processing (Spark/Hadoop) service available

Amazon Athena.note: No managed serverless query service for S3 data available

AWS IAM.note: Project/domain RBAC, federated identity support, scoped API tokens

Amazon Cognito.note: No managed user identity and authentication service available

AWS IAM Identity Center.note: No managed SSO/identity center service available

AWS KMS.note: Key lifecycle management available; no HSM-backed service

AWS Secrets Manager.note: No managed secrets rotation and storage service available

AWS Certificate Manager.note: No managed TLS/SSL certificate provisioning service available

Amazon GuardDuty.note: No managed threat detection service available

AWS Security Hub.note: No managed security posture management service available

AWS Config.note: No managed resource configuration tracking and compliance service available

AWS Shield.note: Data center DDoS mitigation included; no self-service application-layer protection

AWS WAF.note: No managed web application firewall service available

AWS CloudTrail.note: Basic OpenStack API audit logging; limited retention and export options

Amazon CloudWatch.note: Resource metrics exportable to external Prometheus/Grafana; no native integrated dashboard

Amazon SNS.note: No managed pub/sub notification service available

AWS Systems Manager.note: No managed operations and configuration management service available

AWS Cost Explorer.note: Per-project cost reporting available in the OpenStack portal

AWS CodeBuild.note: No managed CI build service available

AWS CodeDeploy.note: No managed deployment automation service available

AWS CodePipeline.note: No managed CI/CD pipeline service available

Amazon ECR.note: Basic container image registry; limited scanning and retention policies

AWS CloudFormation.note: OpenStack Heat templates and Terraform provider available; no native IaC service equivalent to CloudFormation

AWS IoT Core.note: No managed IoT connectivity and messaging service available

AWS IoT Device Management.note: No managed IoT device fleet management service available

Amazon SQS.note: No managed message queue service available

Amazon EventBridge.note: No managed event bus/routing service available

AWS Step Functions.note: No managed serverless workflow orchestration service available

Amazon SES.note: No managed transactional email service available

Amazon Kinesis.note: No managed real-time data streaming service available
